questions.questionText: The central purpose of economic activity is the production of goods and services to satisfy needs and wants. Which of the following is one of the three key decisions that has to be taken to achieve this?
options: How to achieve economies of scale
What goods and services to produce
Whether to maximise profit or sales

questions.questionText: Healthcare in the UK is provided by the public sector and by private firms. Public sector provision ensures that healthcare is free at the point of consumption for individuals without private health insurance and for those unable to pay for healthcare. Which one of the following can be concluded about healthcare in the UK?
options: Healthcare has the characteristics of a private and public good.
Production of healthcare addresses the basic economic questions of ‘how’ and ‘for whom’.
The supply of healthcare achieves productive efficiency.
